alt: A soccer referee crouching on the pitch to spray a white foam vanishing-spray line before a free kick, with players and a packed stadium visible behind him
story: Referee Ivan Barton walked out to officiate the France vs Spain World Cup semi-final on July 15, 2026 without his vanishing spray, forcing the fourth official to sprint onto the pitch mid-free-kick to hand it to him.
why_funny: The vanishing spray is the most referee-specific gadget at the tournament — and the referee forgot it at the biggest match of the year.
